dedupe_keys.name: nepal hospital bed capacity by development region 2013 opennepal from the central bureau of statistics

description: This small table gives the number of hospital beds in each of Nepal's former development regions. OpenNepal extracted it from a Central Bureau of Statistics report published in 2013, which the HDX notes link as a report on a census of private hospitals, and shared it on the Humanitarian Data Exchange in 2014. The single CSV file, named for bed categories, is free to download under the Open Database License (ODbL), which requires attribution and share-alike for derived databases. Coverage is national at the level of the five development regions used before the 2015 constitution created provinces. Caveats: the scope appears limited to the hospitals covered by the census report, so totals may not include all public beds; OpenNepal is inactive, the file sits on its old server and may fail to download, and no methodology is given. Simulation uses: a regional baseline of bed capacity for surge and disaster capacity models in Nepal, such as earthquake response scenarios. Related records: the Nepal municipal solid waste budgets (data-nepal-municipal-solid-waste-management-budgets-2010-2012) are another OpenNepal extract from the same period.
